## Names

<a id="circle_plot_spans"></a>
### [`circle_plot_spans`](../../../../src/graphics/circle_plot.asm#L6) `$3CDE`

*routine*

Plot routine of the disc: draws the row circle_y_down and the row circle_y_up from circle_x_right to circle_x_left with the span routine at $285b. It skips a row outside 0-draw_max_y. It keeps shape_x0, shape_y0 and shape_x1. When circle_y_offset is 0, it returns from the caller of circle_plot.

- **Calls:** [`circle_coordinates`](circle_plot_3d3c.md#circle_coordinates), [`circle_clip_x`](circle_plot_3d3c.md#circle_clip_x), [`line_horizontal`](bresenham_line.md#line_horizontal)
- **Reads:** [`shape_x0`](../../memory-map.md#shape_x0), [`shape_y0`](../../memory-map.md#shape_y0), [`shape_x1`](../../memory-map.md#shape_x1), [`delta_x`](../../memory-map.md#delta_x), [`delta_y`](../../memory-map.md#delta_y), [`max_y`](../../memory-map.md#max_y), [`circle_left_x`](../../memory-map.md#circle_left_x), [`circle_upper_y`](../../memory-map.md#circle_upper_y), [`line_dy`](../../memory-map.md#line_dy), [`line_dx`](../../memory-map.md#line_dx)
- **Writes:** [`shape_x0`](../../memory-map.md#shape_x0), [`max_y`](../../memory-map.md#max_y), [`shape_y0`](../../memory-map.md#shape_y0), [`shape_x1`](../../memory-map.md#shape_x1)
